scripts.deploy-content: npm run zip && aws lambda update-function-code --function-name RunAstraContent --zip-file fileb://lambda.zip

scripts.deploy-social: npm run zip && aws lambda update-function-code --function-name RunAstraSocial --zip-file fileb://lambda.zip
